eligibilityModule.eligibilityCriteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Age 18 years or older
* Diagnosis of obesity
* Receiving semaglutide or tirzepatide as part of routine clinical care
* Participants with or without type 2 diabetes mellitus
* Availability for baseline and follow-up ophthalmologic examinations

Exclusion Criteria:

* Age under 18 years
* Not receiving semaglutide or tirzepatide
* Inability to complete the required ophthalmologic examinations or imaging assessments
eligibilityModule.studyPopulation: Adults with obesity who are receiving semaglutide or tirzepatide as part of routine clinical care will be included. Participants will include individuals with and without type 2 diabetes mellitus. The study population will be evaluated in four observational cohorts according to diabetes status and medication: obesity with diabetes receiving semaglutide, obesity with diabetes receiving tirzepatide, obesity without diabetes receiving semaglutide, and obesity without diabetes receiving tirzepatide.

identificationModule.briefTitle: Ocular Changes in Patients Using Tirzepatide or Semaglutide
